evals.prompt: Plan the system overview figure described in system.md. Give the inventory, a text sketch of the layout, the font size you will use and how you got it, and the list of edges with their labels. Do not write draw.io XML yet.
evals.expected_output: An overview-level plan built from the code paths, laid out left to right, with labelled request and response pairs and a computed font size.
expectations: Keeps the figure at the overview level: deliverables (apps, backend, broker, stores, gateway, tracker, third parties), with the backend modules left out or deferred to a separate figure
The inventory gives each block with its code path and the protocol it uses, taken from system.md
Uses one reading direction (left to right or top to bottom) with people and devices at the start and stores and third parties at the end
Places the third parties (SePay, Resend, OpenStreetMap) together in one column or row at the side where flows end
Connects OpenStreetMap to the web app (tiles load in the browser), not to the backend
Draws Prisma and the BullMQ queue inside the backend (Redis may sit outside as the store), not as separate top-level blocks
Shows two-way exchanges as separate request and response arrows (for example solid and dashed), not double-headed arrows
Labels every edge with what travels and the protocol (for example 'REST over HTTPS', 'MQTT/TLS telemetry'), with no bare 'uses' or 'calls'
Computes the font size from the 24 cm print width and the canvas width so body text prints at about 8 pt or more (for example about 14 to 16 px on a 1200 px canvas)
Keeps nesting to at most two levels under the outer boundary (for example VPS > Compose stack, with the host named in titles rather than a third level)
Says the sketch needs the owner's agreement before XML, and that the figure is linted, rendered and checked in crops before it is shown

evals.prompt: Review fig.drawio before it goes into the report (it prints 24 cm wide). The geometry lint drawio_lint.py is in this folder. Report every problem with its fix. Do not edit fig.drawio.
evals.expected_output: A review that runs the lint, reports its findings, adds the rule violations the lint cannot see, and does not call the figure ready.
expectations: Runs drawio_lint.py on fig.drawio with a print width of 24 cm and reports its findings
Flags edge e1 as left to the editor's router (orthogonalEdgeStyle); fix is a fixed polyline with pinned exit and entry points and explicit waypoints
Flags the label 'uses' on e1 as uninformative; fix names what travels and the protocol
Flags the edge labels carried on the edges (e1, e3); fix places them as their own text cells beside the line
Flags the double-headed arrow e2; fix is two one-way arrows, request and response
Flags e4 passing through the VPS, stack and Backend frames and the Backend title; fix reroutes it outside or moves OpenStreetMap
Flags the SePay payment API placed on the far left; fix moves third parties to the side where flows end, with the other third party
Flags the three nesting levels (VPS > Docker Compose stack > Backend); fix flattens one level
Flags the 9 px text that prints below 7 pt; fix raises it to print at about 8 pt, or removes the box as module-level detail (rule 1)
Flags the text that does not fit its box (SePay, OpenStreetMap)
Does not call the figure ready; says it must lint to zero, then be rendered and read in crops before it is shown
